profile.description: How you appear to the people you work with, and how Greenlit looks for you.
profile.pictureHint: A square picture works best. Drop one here or choose a file.
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: Shown on your notes, reviews and posts.
profile.usernameHint: You sign in with it. An admin can change it in People.
profile.emailHint: An admin can change it in People.
profile.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Other devices stay signed in.
profile.mismatch: The two new passwords are different.
profile.shareSession: You opened Greenlit from a share link, so your profile can’t be changed from here. Sign in with your own account to edit it.

general.description: The workspace’s name, its time zone and the defaults everyone starts with.
general.name: Name
general.nameHint: Shown in the top bar, the browser tab and on the sign-in page.
general.taglineHint: One line under the name on the sign-in page.
general.timeZoneHint: Every date in Greenlit and every schedule sent to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube uses this time zone. Posts already scheduled keep their moment.
general.defaultLanguageHint: For new people and the sign-in page. Everyone can pick their own.
general.weekStartHint: In the calendar and date pickers.
general.publicUrlHint: The address people open Greenlit at. Share links and the Claude Code setup use it.
